experimental_design: proteomic analysis of three bacterial isolates grown in autochthonous seawater medium
Shotgun proteomic analysis of cellular extracts of isolates grown in autochthonous seawater medium was carried out to elucidate the metabolic mechanisms utilizing the bloom DOM.
